_comment: FEMALE clip set. Clip name -> UE AnimSequence asset path. Names are the runtime's state-map keys - do not rename them. Idle/Listening/Speaking supplied by the owner 2026-08-20 from the gendered pack; Shrug is AN_Idle_13, shared with the male set at the owner's direction (it ships under a male_ prefix but is used by both). Focused is gendered as of 2026-08-20, replacing Focused_Anim_Salute whose hand collided with the head (#3255). Thinking is Thinking_AN_Idle_70_Waiting, supplied by the owner 2026-08-21 from the gendered pack and shared between the sets; it replaced TG-Anim_Deep_Breath_Sad, which was never loop-authored and failed the stage-05 loop-seam gate at 3.318 deg (#3269, #3321). The four remaining gestures - Nod, HeadShake, Dismiss, Angry - still point at the previous pack, which UE moved to /Game/Animations/previousPack/ when the gendered pack was installed, and are the slots still awaiting replacements. BreathingIdle, Listening2 and Listening3 added 2026-10-23 (telegamez#4908) from the same gendered pack as Idle/Listening/Speaking, retargeted to MetaHuman with the same retargeter (Telly-retarget, Quinn -> MetaHuman). A first set made with Kimodo tore the polo collar on panda (its arm posture drove the clavicles ~19 deg through the post-process rig) and was replaced. Approved by the owner after review on a clothed character. The 'envelope' block gates them against the production loops on the bones the polo is skinned to. 2026-11-03 (fix/anim-library-defects): HeadShake and Angry were byte-identical in both libraries because /Game/Animations/previousPack/Dialog-IP_Dialogue_furious_idle_03 was imported from IP_Dialogue_furious_idle_02.FBX (its import source), so both slots baked the same 35 s hands-on-hips idle. Both now cut a short window out of a longer take with the {asset,start,end} form (seconds, source time): HeadShake is the head-shake section of No_Anim_No (the same asset as Nod, which is itself a head-shake 'no', not a nod); Angry is the exasperated hand-to-face/arms-out gesture in Serious_gesture_03. Windows were chosen by measured self-penetration under the production rebase, not by eye alone. Nod replaced 2026-11-03 at the owner's direction: No_Anim_No is a head-shake 'no', so Nod is now a single head-pitch 'yes' nod cut from Serious_talk_up_01 (66.0-67.6 s, arms still). Nod and Angry windows were re-chosen under the 'torso' rebase that dev ships since telegamez#5080 (arms as authored); Angry narrowed to 62.2-64.0 s. Wave added 2026-11-03 for the companion action system: TG-Anim_Wave_2 (previous pack, MetaHuman skeleton, fingers animated), right hand raised to head height and waved, whole clip (3.5 s): a 0-3.0 s cut ended with the forearm still 30 deg from its start pose, the full clip returns within 1.8 deg. Chosen over Wave_1/Wave_3 by measured self-penetration with the runtime contact layer on ('torso' rebase). Wave switched to TG-Anim_Wave_3 (whole clip, 2.9 s) 2026-11-03: Wave_2 waved 39 cm above the crown and swung 70 cm out, leaving the bust frame. Wave_3's wave sits beside the head (peak 1-16 cm below the crown, 11-31 cm lateral); only its 0.2-0.5 s raise swings out (59 cm), which the runtime's action camera pull-back covers (telegamez#5095). Action batch 1 (2026-11-03): Facepalm = Sad_talk_02 30.8-33.9 s (hand to face, head bowed, ~2 s hold); Furious = furious_idle_02 25.2-27.6 s (both fists pumping at the chest, then down; fists come from the runtime hand-pose layer; an in-place take - the RM_ furious_talk_up windows carry up to 25 cm of root translation, which the runtime keeps); MiddleFinger = laugh_talk_low_01 31.2-34.1 s (right hand up to chest, back of hand to camera, ~0.8 s hold; the finger itself comes from the hand-pose layer). Windows chosen by measured self-penetration with the contact layer on.
